SPECIFICATION FOR BUSHING FOR CLOCK HANDS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and general requirements of bushing for clock hands. 
2: Definitions 

2.1 Clearance Fit Bushes— Bushes which are having clearance with the spindle and fixed with a 
pin or nut. 

2.2 Fit on Hands — Bushes which are fitted loose on the spindle and fixed with a pin or nut. 
3= Types 



Type A — Bushes with round hole 
Type B — Bushes with square hole 
Type C — Bushes with unsiotted hole 
Type D — Bushes with slotted hole 
Type E — Bushes with elongated hole 

4. Dimensions 

4.1 Type A — Bushes with round hole. 



l preferably for minute hand and second hand

5. Material-— Bushes shall be machined from brass bars/rods conforming to IS: 319-1974 
'Specification for free cutting brass bars, rods and sections'. 

6. Finish — The bushes shall be free from burrs, cracks and other manufacturing defects. 

7. Designation 

a) Bushing for clock hands of Type A with round hole of diameter c/i == 2 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Bushing for clock hand, A2, IS ; 12477 

b) Bushing for clock hands of Type B with square hole of S = 2'5 mm shall be designated as: 

Bushing for clock hand, B2*5, IS : 12477 

c) Bushing for clock hands of Type C of t/i ^ 5 mm and / = 3"5 mm shall be designated as: 

Bushing for clock hand, C5x3'5, IS : 12477 

8. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier, the sampling 
plan, shall be as given in 8.1 to 8.3. 

8.1 Z.of— In a consignment, all the bushes of same type and size and manufactured from the same 
material under similar conditions of production shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. 

8.2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lot, the procedure for sampling and inspection as given 
in IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count 
of defects { first revision )\ shall be followed. The type of sampling plan, inspection level and 
acceptable quality level ( AQL ) to be followed for various characteristics shall be as given in 8.2.1 . 

8.3 For dimensions, finish and designation, a single sampling plan with Inspection Level IV and AQL 
of 1'5 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-l973 shall be followed. 

9. Packing — Bushes for clock hands shall be wrapped in tissue paper and then packed in quantities 
not exceeding 100 pieces, in a suitable cardboard containers. Different types and sizes of bushes 
shall not be packed in the same packing. 

10. Marlcing — The label containing each pack shall be marked with the manufacturer's name or 
trade-mark, if any; type, size and quantity of bushes to ensure proper identification. 

10.1 Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to clocks. In the preparation of 
this standard, assistance has been drawn from the following: 

DIN 8270-1966 Hands for clocks, fitting dimensions^ fits, combinations of dimensions. 
Deutsches Institut fiir Normung ( Germany). 

DIN 8271-1979 Bushing for hands for clocks Deutsches Institut fCir Normung ( Germany ).
